reading-log/features/customizable_title_: Toggle the page title on/off with a checkbox.
reading-log/features/handwriting_fields_: Date, page, and notes appear as ruled blank lines for handwriting.
reading-log/features/preprinted_fields_d: Book title and author are pre-printed on every card, with auto-truncation for long text.
reading-log/features/print_ready_desc: A4 portrait layout with dashed cut lines between cards, ready to print or save as PDF.
reading-log/how_to_use/step1: Enter a page title (optional) and the book title and author in the settings.
reading-log/how_to_use/step2: Choose 1 or 2 column header layout and adjust notes rows per card.
reading-log/how_to_use/step3: The preview updates automatically as you type.
reading-log/how_to_use/step4: Click Print to print the cards with cut lines, or Download to save as an image.
reading-log/note: Generate printable A4 reading log cards with pre-printed title and author. Supports 1 or 2 column layouts with adjustable notes rows and cut lines.
reading-log/tags: reading log, book tracker, printable, reading list, book cards, A4
